title: Beti
desc: Sudha assumes a recent acquaintance is the man she's being asked to marry and agrees to the match. When she realises her mistake it's too late, and she has to choose between love and family honour.

title: Khoon Ka Karz
desc: Two young friends are raised in the same orphanage by an affectionate warden. Although they promise her not to stray, fate makes them the biggest gangsters in town. Will she be able to save them now?

title: Hasina Maan Jayegi
desc: Rakesh and Kamal, doppelgangers of one another, fall for the same woman, Archana. However, when their petty rivalry evolves into something more sinister, she must find her true love.

title: Kaash
desc: Following a serious box office flop, movie star-turned-producer Ritesh (Jackie Shroff) and his wife, Pooja (Dimple Kapadia), are forced to downgrade to a simpler lifestyle. This leads to the husband becoming an alcoholic, the wife taking a menial job as a chambermaid, and their young child being forced to watch as his parents' relationship disintegrates. Ritesh and Pooja are living apart when their son is diagnosed with a fatal brain tumor, which leads to a bittersweet reunion for all three.

title: Hitler
desc: Siddhanth Sharma, a strict disciplinarian, is forced to chase hi brother, Amar, after he is accused of murder. However, his wife, Sheila, a lawyer, decides to defend Amar.
